unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 10 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.2 - THEME 1: SCHOOL LIFE & EDUCATION

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will prepare an oral presentation on any of these sub-themes: problems at school, challenges and problems for students in education, the role of parents in their children’s education, or the purpose of education. The presentation should include a personal or fictional story and a proposed solution to the challenge by integrating target vocabulary items into the presentation from the list provided to them. Students are expected to use ''present tenses, be used to / get used to, conjunctions, and complex question tags'' during the presentation. They are also expected to relate their presentation to cultural or national events, such as National Sovereignty and Children’s Day or Victory Day, to emphasise their influence on education or student motivation. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''school life and education with its components such as school problems; challenges for students role of parents in education; purpose of education; national days and celebrations'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in after prep year 10 of an upper secondary school may know what school problems; challenges for students in education; role of parents in education; purpose of education; national days and celebrations mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in after prep year 10 of upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''school life and education'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in the after prep year 10 of an upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''school life and education with its components such as school problems; challenges for students role of parents in education; purpose of education; national days and celebrations'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Their knowledge of the days of the week and holidays will help them learn and practise important national holidays such as ''the Republic Day of Türkiye''. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/ or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To describe an ideal school, addressing school problems, the role of parents, and the purpose of education in English through a writing activity by using target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity 1: Designing the Future of Education Students write a detailed paragraph about their ideal school by using target vocabulary and target grammar such as the Present Perfect Tense and complex question tags. They discuss problems at school, the role of their parents, and the purpose of education. For example: ''My ideal school has accurate and fair evaluation and assessment ways and provides motivation to students. The parents permanently assist with their children’s challenges, don’t they?''. After writing, students share their paragraphs in small groups and discuss the main ideas, and then they suggest improvements. The teacher gives feedback on the use of the language including target pronunciation and correct use of the target vocabulary and target grammar. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To describe an ideal school in written and spoken forms in English by using target vocabulary. Activity 1: My Ideal School Students use a word bank with some visual clues (e.g. assistance, motivation) to complete a worksheet for filling in the blanks about their ideal school. Example sentences include: ''My ideal school provides __________ (motivation, assistance) for students'' or ''The teachers are __________ (kind, professional)''. After filling in the blanks, students read their sentences aloud to the class. The teacher gives positive feedback on the language use with target vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation and their accuracy. At the end of the activity, the teacher guides them to play digital word games using the target vocabulary to consolidate their learning in an interactive and fun way. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
